description: Gas remains a network carrier with the PyPSA-Eur treatment: biogas upgrading credits -0.198 tCO2/MWh at the producer (97 links), gas consumers book the fossil EF; Sabatier/methanation is not active in the S3 network (upstream option methanation false); the origin of pipeline gas is not traceable (asymmetry stated)

Imported green carriers (FT fuel on ASEAN oil non-fossil, methanol on ASEAN methanol, ammonia, liquid H2) carry no CO2 port and their consumers book zero (origin_neutral); producer_credit caps imported methanol at 0 (no regional atmosphere to credit)

Oil split into a fossil pool (ASEAN oil + node oil buses, consumer meters with the fossil EF) and a non-fossil pool (ASEAN oil non-fossil + node 'oil non-fossil' buses fed by Fischer-Tropsch, BtL and FT imports, twin consumer meters without atmosphere port); methanol: no fossil production route in the 2050 technology set, so the single regional methanol bus is the non-fossil bus

Main fuel carbon attribution = origin_neutral (decision 64): non-fossil liquid fuels zero at combustion and no producer credit; fossil-captured synfuels booked in the producer atmosphere at synthesis; imported green fuels zero; sensitivity producer_credit = S2 behaviour (switch research.s3.fuel_carbon_mode)

PyPSA-Eur v2025.07.0 has no fuel-origin tracking: single oil and methanol buses, consumers book the fossil EF (shipping oil 5261-5270, shipping methanol 5218-5227, industry methanol 4617-4626), producers credit (FT/methanolisation from co2 stored 4628-4645, biomass-to-methanol 983-1002, biogas upgrading, Sabatier); with one European atmosphere the credit and the emission cancel, with 11 national atmospheres they do not (decision 64)

Singapore international bunker methanol 465.5 TWh/a: origin_neutral books 0 in SG (carbon booked at the producing node's synthesis or zero for imports); producer_credit would book 465.5 TWh x 0.2482 = 115.5 MtCO2/a in SG, more than SG's structural unavoidable CO2 (54.9 Mt) with no domestic storage
